note: Original ability, item and matchup data for BURN City: The Wilds milestone 1. Balance is a first pass for the prototype.

burn.name: Burn
burn.text: loses a little health each turn

root.name: Root
root.text: can't flee and is easier to bind

leaf_flick.name: Leaf Flick
leaf_flick.text: A whip of razor leaves. May Root.

soothing_call.name: Soothing Call
soothing_call.text: A low hum that settles the foe (bind odds up) and mends a little.

spark_nip.name: Spark Nip
spark_nip.text: A hot little bite. May Burn.

flare_dash.name: Flare Dash
flare_dash.text: A blazing charge. Strong but can miss.

water_thread.name: Water Thread
water_thread.text: A lasso of creek water. May Root.

mist_bubble.name: Mist Bubble
mist_bubble.text: Wraps itself in mist: Guarded, clears Burn.

burrow_stance.name: Burrow Stance
burrow_stance.text: Digs in: Guarded and mends a little.

brace.name: Brace
brace.text: Plant your feet: Guarded for two turns.

soothe.name: Soothe
soothe.text: Speak softly, hands open. Settles the foe (bind odds up).

starter_binding_charm.name: Starter Binding Charm
starter_binding_charm.text: Mara's woven charm. +12% on your next bind attempt (used up on the attempt).

field_bait.name: Field Bait
field_bait.text: Sweet root mash. Use in an encounter: +10% bind odds for that encounter, and the creature settles.

trail_sigil.name: Trail Sigil
trail_sigil.text: The basic binding mark every warden carries. Never runs out.
